name: MotionShine
tagline: Free Mac screen recorder with auto zoom and a camera bubble.
description:
MotionShine is a screen recorder for Mac that records your screen and lets you edit the same recording inside the app. It adds an automatic zoom on every click and a smooth cursor you can restyle, so a tutorial or product demo looks polished without a separate editor.

## Features

- Auto zoom on every click. Each zoom is a block you can move, change or delete.
- A smooth cursor you can restyle: style, colour and size, plus click effects or your own picture.
- A camera bubble, or a camera layout you can change after you record.
- Records your microphone and the Mac's own sound together, each with its own volume.
- Captions made on the Mac in more than 40 languages. Every word can be fixed, and captions export in the video or as .srt and .vtt files.
- Export to MP4 or GIF.

## Where it fits

MotionShine is for people who make tutorials, product demos and walkthroughs and want zoom, cursor and camera control in one app. It exports files only; there are no share links.

## Privacy and requirements

Requires macOS 13 or later. Captions are generated on the Mac, according to the developer. Downloading asks for an email address, which then receives a free licence key.

## Pricing

Free has every feature, with no watermark and no time limit, and exports up to 720p at 30 fps. Pro is a one-time payment with no subscription, for 1080p up to 4K and up to 60 fps. See motionshine.com/#pricing for current prices.
